general_information.name: OH—MY FULL LEGAL NAME? I… I THINK YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY DOCUMENTS, RIGHT? I’M NOT GREAT WITH THIS PART. IT’S ELEANOR… UM, HAYWOOD. BUT IF YOU NEED IT EXACTLY AS IT APPEARS, I MIGHT BE MIXING UP THE ORDER OF HOW YOU WANT IT SAID.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly this low mood that just seems to sit there most days, for years really, and I feel pretty hard on myself a lot. And then—this is the bit that really sticks—I keep worrying I’m going to end up like my father did. He died by suicide when I was twelve, and I know that sounds… I just can’t stop that thought coming in. But I’m not thinking about doing anything to myself, just to be clear.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to stop feeling like my father’s death is my future. And I want to break that pattern for my own daughter too… that’s really what I’m hoping for.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and my father died when I was 12. As a young child… I don’t know, I suppose I was probably a bit serious even then.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I finished school and my social work degree. I’ve always thought of myself as pretty serious, and that’s… that’s most of what comes to mind right now.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m married, and it’s been about 15 years. It’s current. We have one child.
